rule: A gap closes only with a new native or browser observation saved under acceptance/. Static code and installed state never close a gap.

gaps.title: Native MCP Manager operations and safe financial delegation are unavailable
gaps.blockedBy: No shipped Manager package or public delegation contract that preserves the exact originating Agent, tool approval and monotonic floor.
gaps.notClaimed: Manager pass, commercial source access, OAuth
gaps.nextStep: Obtain a public delegation contract, or keep the documented compatibility boundary.

gaps.title: In-process authoring works; delivery into the workspace and recalculation are blocked
gaps.blockedBy: ctx.fs has no binary write and the confined subprocess exits 0xC0000142, so bytes cannot land in the workspace or be recalculated.
gaps.notClaimed: Agent-generated Office files in the workspace, recalculated workbooks, visual layout
gaps.nextStep: Host supplies a binary artifact write (or a usable confined subprocess); authoring and specification are already proven.

gaps.title: Ten native business runs with licensed data have not been executed
gaps.blockedBy: No licensed commercial data entitlement; Office channel blocked as above.
gaps.notClaimed: Any business E2E or commercial output
gaps.nextStep: Run per-business inputs once data or Office delivery becomes available.

gaps.title: Operating-system process restart has not been compared
gaps.blockedBy: Requires restarting the Desktop application; only bundle-level remove/reinstall and disable/enable were exercised.
gaps.nextStep: Restart the app after recording a review, then re-read the queue projection.

gaps.title: Every client page is unverified in a browser
gaps.blockedBy: No browser automation in this session; code, build, install and dispatch are verified instead.
gaps.notClaimed: Visual acceptance, responsive layout, contrast, keyboard reachability
gaps.nextStep: Follow acceptance/MANUAL_CHECKLIST.md and save the observation.

gaps.title: Deliverables cannot yet be opened or traced back to their Session from the UI
gaps.blockedBy: Needs a native file card or preview entry point bound to the indexed path and Session.
gaps.notClaimed: Open, preview or jump to Session
gaps.nextStep: Wire the indexed deliverable to the native preview once the entry point is confirmed.

gaps.title: UI behaviour across install, upgrade, disable, reinstall is unverified
gaps.blockedBy: Requires driving the Plugin Manager and the browser together.
gaps.nextStep: Record each lifecycle step in the manual checklist.

gaps.title: Element-tree structure is checked; contrast, focus order and reflow are not
gaps.blockedBy: Only a rendered page can show contrast, screen-reader output and focus behaviour.
gaps.notClaimed: WCAG conformance, narrow-screen acceptance, screen-reader output
gaps.nextStep: Inspect contrast, focus ring and a 520px viewport in the browser.

gaps.title: Diagnostic codes are stored and projected; per-business source lineage is missing
gaps.blockedBy: Stage records carry whitelisted codes only; no source or adapter grouping exists yet.
gaps.nextStep: Group codes by source and adapter once business runs exist.
